title: Visit London
text:
Visitor numbers

import csv

with open("data/attractions.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))

top = max(rows, key=lambda r: int(r["visits_2025"]))
top_name = top["attraction"]
top_visits = int(top["visits_2025"])
total_visits = sum(int(r["visits_2025"]) for r in rows)

The most visited attraction in 2025 was the Natural History Museum (South Kensington), with 7,116,929 visits, out of 39,692,434 visits in total across the ten attractions listed.








Figure 1: Visits in 2025 to London’s ten most-visited ALVA attractions. Source: ALVA.

title: Visit London
text: Welcome to London, a city where centuries of history sit side by side with modern life. Whether you’re wandering along the Thames, exploring world-class museums, or simply enjoying a pint in a cosy pub, you’ll find that there is something for every traveller around each corner.
